title: Find a pattern
description:
Search a buffer for a byte pattern, with `?` meaning any byte.

```
pattern 48 8B ?? 10 found at offsets 4, 12
pattern FF FF not found
```
hints: The last start position to try is `size - pattern.size()`; check `pattern.size() <= size` first, because `size_t` cannot go negative (lesson 2.03).

To split the pattern text at spaces, read it word by word from a string stream: `std::istringstream in{ text }; std::string token; while (in >> token) { ... }` (from `<sstream>`, already included). Each `token` is one byte like `"8B"` or `"??"`.
`std::stoi(token, nullptr, 16)` reads one hex byte; `"??"` becomes -1.
requirements: `std::vector<std::size_t> findAll(const unsigned char* data, std::size_t size, const std::vector<int>& pattern)`, where -1 is a wildcard.
Parse the pattern from text like `"48 8B ?? 10"`.
Never read past the end of the buffer.
stretch: Make the search faster by skipping ahead with the first non-wildcard byte and `std::memchr` (look it up in `<cstring>`: it finds the first occurrence of one byte value in a block of memory).
